sourceNote: Per-location data (armor per location incl. rear, internal structure, weapon locations/rear mounts, ammo bins, crit slots, heat sinks, MP, BV) transcribed from the official free record sheet booklet 'BattleTech Record Sheets: A Game of Armored Combat' (battletech.com/downloads, 'RS AGoAC Epub 1-26-19a'; 15 sheets, PDF pp. 2-16). Head internal structure is not printed on the sheets and comes from the AGOAC p. 50 Internal Structure Table. Engine ratings and chassis descriptions from Sarna chassis pages (fetched 2026-11-24); MUL was unreachable. Weapons table from AGOAC rulebook p. 55. Extra fields vs. schema: rulesLevel, engine, armorTons, armorTotalPoints (sum of sheet armor), maxArmor. Crit 'Roll Again' = empty slot as printed on the sheet.
